params.caption: 🎮 id Software confirms its next game is in the works Xbox CEO Asha Sharma revealed the Doom studio's new project in her Xbox 25th anniversary posts on X, and id followed up: teams in Texas and Frankfurt are on it, with Hugo Martin directing again. Details are far off – "It'll be some time" before more is shared. The news lands months after id lost over 130 staff in Xbox layoffs, while Slaughter Mode hits Doom: The Dark Ages on Nov 16. 🕒 Nov 13, 2026 · 00:07 (GMT+3) 📰 Sources: GameSpot · PC Gamer 👥 @Xbox · @bethesda 🔥 React if you want a new Doom · 💬 Or is it Quake's turn? #Doom #idSoftware #Xbox #GamingNews
